items.title: Maude Johnson Interview, 1959-01-06
items.q: that's where when he got to Crowley he played a couple of nights with Evanne Thomas' band.

ctx.x: Where he played with the circus band for a while. No it wasn't there. Yeah. The world, I mean the state fair, was there a fair, he was there one year, stopped. But I think he was with the minstrel shows then and just happened to play a little bit with the circus band. Yeah.

Well that's where he had went up there. He might have been in Kansas then too. I think it was in Kansas because I was in New Iberia and then he went up there and he said he was coming back home because he wasn't doing so good up there. And at that time when he was on the way back home he was playing with little short bands in different towns on the way back home. And that's where when he got to Crowley he played a couple of nights with Evanne Thomas' band. When would that be?
About 1932 or 3? About a year after you moved in New Iberia.
